scripts.prepare:project: bash ./scripts/generate-config.sh && yarn workspace @fishjam-cloud/ios-client prepare:project && xcodegen generate --quiet
scripts.build: yarn prepare:project && xcodebuild build -project FishjamExample.xcodeproj -scheme FishjamExample -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -quiet
scripts.start: yarn build && xcrun simctl install booted build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/FishjamExample.app && xcrun simctl launch booted io.fishjam.example
